question: Should OpenClaw accept this curated OpenRouter Images API model expansion now, after rebase, or defer it behind the broader OpenRouter catalog-policy issue?
rationale: The patch is a feature/provider-routing policy choice tied to an open issue already labeled for maintainer product review, and it changes behavior for credential-backed OpenRouter model refs.

options.title: Land Curated Images API Update After Rebase
options.body: Accept the provider-local curated list and `/images` route once current-main capability prefix behavior and tests are preserved.

options.title: Narrow The Model Set
options.body: Limit the PR to the highest-confidence requested model IDs and defer the rest to a catalog-policy follow-up.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog Policy
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of resolving the broader model discovery/catalog direction in the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Land Curated Images API Update After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the provider-local curated list and `/images` route once current-main capability prefix behavior and tests are preserved.
